thresholds.method: Five fresh processes per case; one full warmup and three measured transcripts. Late cases require each CPU and latency reduction >= max(5,ceil(2*baseline median relative max deviation)). Stock and all RSS allow <= max(1,ceil(baseline deviation)) regression. Both frozen and contemporaneous controls must pass independently. Final timing requires all four cases, five processes each. DB/WAL +1% guard, exact behavior and existing30-room gates separately required. No threshold revision after implementation.

encoding.reconstruction: gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(entry.data)) reproduces the original bytes. Every JSON field, identity mapping, source byte and log line is retained. This is evidence storage, not a production codec.
